        int w = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();

        System.out.print(check(w, m, 0, 0) ? "YES" : "NO");
    }

    private static boolean check(int w, int m, int pos, int carry) {
        if (pos > 100) {
            return carry != 1;
        }

        int digit = m % w;
        int nextM = m / w;

        digit += carry;
        carry = digit / w;
        digit %= w;

        if (digit == 0 || digit == 1) {
            return check(w, nextM, pos + 1, carry);
        }
        if (digit == w - 1) {
            return check(w, nextM, pos + 1, 1);
        }
        return false;
    }
}
